name: Mouth Jamboree
description: A squeezed-half-flat tube of Mouth Jamboree kids' toothpaste: glossy creased blue laminate, a white shoulder and threaded neck with Sparkle Jam gel crusted in the threads, a red confetti Cavity Patrol band, a crimped end with a LOT/EXP stamp, cap knobs, Jam Facts on the back, a used toothbrush and the cap left on the counter.
